legend.name: The Golden Child
legend.text: A few weeks have passed since the Golden Child of legend, (child) was born. Already (child.he/she) has shown unparalleled wisdom and an uncanny ability to generate things out of thin air. However, (child.he/she) hasn't spoken a word, even though (child.he/she) appears to be around five years old.

class.name: The class
class.text: The other children seem to avoid (child.him/her) due to (child.his/her) special powers. Some are frightened, some are curious, and some simply have no idea what to make of (child.him/her). (Child) doesn't seem troubled, but no one can really understand what (child.he/she)'s thinking. (Teacher), the schoolteacher, is wondering how (teacher.he/she) can help little (child) integrate better with (child.his/her) peers.
